subject: gk
question: Which of the following is a Fundamental Duty of a citizen?

options.text: To indulge in a profitable trade

solution:
The correct answer is __**To preserve rich heritage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fundamental Duties of citizens are enshrined in **Article 51A** of the Constitution of India.
 
• One of the Fundamental Duties includes **preserving the rich heritage of India’s composite culture**.
 
• These duties were added to the Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**, inspired by the Constitution of the former USSR.
 
• Preserving heritage involves maintaining historical monuments, traditional arts, languages, and cultural practices.
 
• Fundamental Duties are non-enforceable by law but serve as moral obligations for citizens to uphold the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties:**

 
 
• There are **11 Fundamental Duties** listed in the Constitution of India.
 
• These duties were introduced based on recommendations of the **Swaran Singh Committee**.
 
• Examples include respecting the national symbols, protecting the environment, and promoting harmony.
 
 
 
• **Heritage Conservation:**
 
 
• India is home to **40 UNESCO World Heritage Sites**, including cultural and natural heritage landmarks.
 
• Organizations such as the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** play a key role in conserving heritage structures.
 
 
 
• **42nd Amendment Act:**
 
 
• The 42nd Amendment, also known as the "Mini Constitution," was passed in **1976**.
 
• It added Fundamental Duties, modified the Preamble, and made several changes to strengthen the central government.
 
 
 
• **Legal Framework for Heritage Protection:**
 
 
• The **Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958** governs the preservation of monuments in India.
 
• Citizens can actively contribute by participating in awareness campaigns and sustainable tourism practices.
